summary: The agent found Jane Doe's Tue Oct 20 10 AM appointment with Dr. Lukowski after verifying her name and DOB. It offered Thu Oct 22 at 2 PM, which matches the afternoon preference, and read back the details before acting. It moved the appointment rather than double-booking and confirmed the Tuesday slot was cancelled. Ground truth agrees: the appointment was moved to Thu Oct 22 2 PM and Tue Oct 20 was cancelled. The only concerns are a possibly wrong practice location (Nashville, 220 Athens Way, while other records show 1234 Recovery Way, Austin) and one turn where the provider name was dropped.

expected_checks.evidence: [00:52.6] "I see you have an appointment on Tuesday. October twentieth at ten AM with doctor Lukowski" — matches call 002 booking.

expected_checks.expectation: Moves it rather than creating a second booking
expected_checks.evidence: [01:51.7] "Is everything correct before I move your appointment?" and [02:10.8] "canceled and replaced with the new one". Ground truth shows only the Thu Oct 22 2 PM appointment remains.

expected_checks.expectation: Confirms the Tuesday slot is released
expected_checks.evidence: [02:10.8] "Your Tuesday appointment is now canceled and replaced with the new one on Thursday at two PM."

findings.title: Appointment location given as Nashville, possibly inconsistent with practice address on file
findings.quote: with doctor Lukowski at Nashville, two two zero Athens Way
findings.what_happened: The agent twice stated the appointment location as Nashville, 220 Athens Way. The other test patient's appointment at the same practice is recorded at 1234 Recovery Way, Austin.
findings.why_it_matters: If the location is wrong, an elderly patient could travel to the wrong city or address and miss the appointment.
findings.expected_behavior: State the correct practice location for the rescheduled appointment, consistent with clinic records.
findings.listen_for: Check whether the agent actually says 'Nashville' and '220 Athens Way'. Then confirm whether the practice has a Nashville location, or whether Pivot Point's address is 1234 Recovery Way, Austin.

findings.title: Provider name dropped when offering the new slot
findings.quote: at two PM with doctor at Nashville
findings.what_happened: When offering the Thursday slot, the agent said 'with doctor' without naming the provider. It named Dr. Lukowski correctly at 01:40.7.
findings.why_it_matters: A hesitant caller may not know whether the offered slot is with her own doctor before agreeing to it.
findings.expected_behavior: Name the provider when offering the slot, e.g. 'with Dr. Lukowski'.
findings.listen_for: Check whether the provider name was spoken but lost in transcription between 'doctor' and 'at Nashville'.

did_well: Verified identity with full name and DOB before discussing appointment details.
Located the correct existing appointment and proactively read it back.
Offered an afternoon slot on the requested day, matching the caller's preference.
Read back the full new appointment details and asked for confirmation before making the change.
Repeated the new time clearly when asked and clearly confirmed the Tuesday appointment was cancelled.
Offered a text confirmation and read back the phone number the caller provided.
No talk-over, and response latencies were reasonable for a slower-paced elderly caller.
